derivation:
by
  funext k
  simpa (disch := omega) [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def, Fin.ext_iff] using Equiv.congr_fun (Equiv.mul_swap_eq_swap_mul (Equiv.swap (⟨i, h0⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ * Equiv.swap ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩) ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩) k
explanation: The declaration states f * swap a b = swap (f a) (f b) * f. Specializing f to the product of the two adjacent swaps gives the desired braid relation; its images of a and b simplify to b and c.
